title: Camera
mode_scan_a11y: Scan a barcode or QR code

live_cues_body: Live cues keep barcode detection hot and sample the view for lightweight labels every few seconds. OCR and entities fill in after you capture or import a frame and run Analyze.
live_scan_hint: Point the camera at a sign, form, receipt, menu, QR code, or document to start seeing live cues.
